name: Fluorite ~Hotaruishi~
source:
The story revolves around a hotel, a strange glowing stone, the ghost of a young girl who is haunting the main character and there are six heroines.

[From[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=461&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕一间酒店、一块会发出奇异光芒的石头，以及纠缠主人公的少女幽灵展开，另有六名女主角登场。

[摘自[url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=461&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
